title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - GaiaXEntity
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/GaiaXEntity. Root class for Gaia-X entities. The source ontology marks this as an abstract root class, parent to ServiceOffering, InstantiationRequirement, DigitalServiceOffering, Ecosystem, EcoTrustScope, EcoTSP, Participant and Resource; included here per the full-ontology translation scope.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GaiaXEntity'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. A human readable name of the entity.

description.description: Property. A human readable description of the entity.

label.description: Property. A human-readable label, automatically entailed via RDFS inference from schema:name in the source ontology.
